description: This file implements the core registry and collection logic for Prometheus metrics, including registration, gathering, and validation of metrics and descriptors. It defines the Registry type, interfaces for collectors and gatherers, and functions for managing metric collection and exposition.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Core structure managing metric collectors, registration, and gathering of metrics.

classes.name: MultiError
classes.description: Type representing multiple errors encountered during metric gathering.

classes.name: GathererFunc
classes.description: Adapter to turn functions into Gatherer implementations.

classes.name: noTransactionGatherer
classes.description: Wrapper for a Gatherer that implements TransactionalGatherer with a no-op done function.

classes.name: MultiTRegistry
classes.description: Aggregates multiple TransactionalGatherers, merging their metrics.

methods.description: Registers a collector with the registry.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a collector from the registry.

methods.description: Gathers metrics from all registered collectors.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Collects metrics from all registered collectors.

methods.name: WriteToTextfile
methods.description: Exports gathered metrics to a text file in Prometheus format.

methods.description: Gathers metrics from multiple transactional gatherers.
